include_directories(
    include
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/win32ss/include)

spec2def(gdi32_vista.dll gdi32_vista.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_library(gdi32_vista_static rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(gdi32_vista_static win32ksys)
add_dependencies(gdi32_vista_static psdk)

# gdi32_vista.dll is all Rust (gdi32_vista-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/gdi32_vista-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# dc.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/gdi32_vista-rust/src/gdi32_vista/dc.rs)
# d3dkmt.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/gdi32_vista-rust/src/gdi32_vista/d3dkmt.rs)
add_cargo_module(gdi32_vista gdi32_vista-cargo gdi32_vista.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE gdi32_vista-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS asm psdk)
